entities.name: Query protein 505 aa
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A2SPI9 from Methanocorpusculum labreanum.
Predicted length 505 aa, molecular weight 53.29 kDa, theoretical pI 6.01, and charge at pH 7 of approximately -3.9.
Best-supported function is AMP phosphorylase, EC 2.4.2.57.
Catalyzes AMP + phosphate ⇌ adenine + alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate; reviewed homologs also act on CMP and UMP.
Likely participates in an archaeal AMP degradation pathway with ribose-1,5-bisphosphate isomerase and RubisCO.
Predicted cytosolic enzyme; no transmembrane or signal-peptide evidence was reported.
Pfam domains: Glycos_trans_3N PF02885 at residues 91-151, Glycos_transf_3 PF00591 at residues 159-388, and PYNP_C PF07831 at residues 425-490.
No specific cofactor requirement or oligomeric state was established by the available analysis.

entities.name: AMP phosphorylase reaction
observations: AMP + phosphate ⇌ alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate + adenine; Rhea RHEA:36975; EC 2.4.2.57.

entities.name: CMP phosphorylase reaction
observations: CMP + phosphate ⇌ cytosine + alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate; Rhea RHEA:36987; reported as additional substrate activity in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: UMP phosphorylase reaction
observations: UMP + phosphate ⇌ uracil + alpha-D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate; Rhea RHEA:36991; reported as additional substrate activity in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Archaeal AMP degradation
observations: AMP phosphorylase is reported in an archaeal AMP degradation pathway together with ribose-1,5-bisphosphate isomerase and RubisCO.
